playtimeUnlocks.text: Conveniences such as /enderchest and /fly are proposed playtime rewards. Unlock hours, restrictions, and progression requirements will be published before launch.

playtimeUnlocks.text: Periodically claimable utility kits, such as an AE2 starter kit, may be available through progression.

rules.title: Respect other players
rules.text: Treat other players respectfully. Harassment, threats, hate speech, discrimination, impersonation, and sharing private personal information are not allowed.

rules.title: No griefing or theft
rules.text: Do not damage, steal from, trap, or interfere with another player’s builds, items, creatures, or machines without permission. This applies to unclaimed builds as well as claims. Do not use explosions, fluids, mobs, or machinery to bypass protection.

rules.title: No cheating or exploit abuse
rules.text: Do not use unauthorized cheats, duplication bugs, or exploits that bypass progression or permissions. Intended abilities and items included in Mythforge are allowed unless staff has restricted them. Report bugs privately and do not distribute exploited items.

rules.title: PvP requires consent
rules.text: PvP requires agreement from everyone involved. Consent to one fight is not permission for repeated attacks, spawn camping, trapping, or taking someone’s belongings. Respect a player’s request to stop.

rules.title: Claims and abandoned bases
rules.text: Claim the land you use and be careful when granting access. Do not surround another claim, block its access, or claim land solely to prevent someone’s expansion. Staff handles abandoned bases and claim disputes; an empty base is not permission to loot or demolish it.

rules.title: Automation and server performance
rules.text: Do not intentionally cause lag or crashes. Keep farms, entities, machines, and chunk loading reasonable. Staff may pause or adjust systems causing measurable performance problems. Do not bypass imposed limits or re-create a disabled setup.

rules.title: Playtime and AFK systems
rules.text: Do not use macros, movement loops, or other tricks to evade AFK detection or inflate rewards. Follow the published conditions of any reward system when it is enabled.

rules.title: Chat and community conduct
rules.text: Avoid spam, repeated unwanted messages or teleport requests, unsolicited advertising, explicit sexual content, and scams. Keep usernames, skins, build names, and public messages appropriate for a shared community.

rules.title: Staff decisions and appeals
rules.text: Follow staff instructions during an incident. Moderation may include warnings, mutes, temporary restrictions, or bans depending on severity. Do not evade sanctions with another account. Contact staff privately through Discord to appeal and provide relevant evidence.

changelog.title: Mythforge - Beyond the Horizon-1.2.4.zip
changelog.notes:
Added Mods


Akashic Tome

Patchouli

Galosphere

Galosphere: Spellbooks

Born in Chaos

Cataclysm of Chaos

Loot Integrations: Born in Chaos

ANARCHY Minibosses

Create: Mechanical Botany

More RPG Classes - Skill Tree

Create Collision Fix

Sphere Projector

SilverLib


Added Datapacks


Hostile Neural Networks: Extra Data Models

Anti Enderman Grief

One Player Sleep

Supplementaries Compat

Cataclysm Compat


Removed Mods


Abyssal Ocean / Hadal Depths

Removed an incompatible MoreRelics addon introduced during development.


Progression & Guides


Removed the main quest progression and its old rewards.

Removed automatic quest-book handouts.

Removed quest requirements from Refuge travel.

Updated Refuge NPCs with simple greetings and travel options.

Players now receive an Akashic Tome containing 17 mod guides.

Fixed the AE2 and Spectrum guides inside the Tome.

Fixed blank guidebook entries and added clearer book names.

Advanced Peripherals and Mine Cells no longer give separate books automatically. Their guides remain in the Tome.


Gacha Changes


Wardens now reward Minor Gamba tokens.

Kept the 30-minute reward cooldown.

Updated token names, descriptions, and tooltips.

Removed the old custom tokens and Refuge gacha machine.


Fixes & Improvements


Fixed “Second Chances” and “Going Up?” unlocking when unrelated blocks were placed.

Removed the overlapping Accessories shortcut from the inventory.

Disabled the Create Aeronautics Structures Telegram welcome message.

Disabled the CSC whitelist reminder.

Discovery traders now disappear after 40 minutes of loaded time.

Enabled obstacle avoidance for Discovery aircraft and patrols.

Improved claim protection and limited excessive chunk loading.

Restricted selected capture mechanics, remote access features, and problematic items.

Updated Reliquified Artifacts to resolve its compatibility crash.

Updated numerous existing mods, including ModernFix, Quark, BetterEnd, Ice and Fire, and several RPG Series addons.


Pack Cleanup


Removed unused quest scripts and old campaign files.

Removed leftover configs from uninstalled mods.

Cleaned out obsolete settings, temporary files, and old backups.

Disabled the unused KubeJS web server.

changelog.notes:
Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon - Update from 1.0.4.3

Main changes



Replaced the previous quest book with a WIP notice while quests undergo further development.




Added a custom main menu with layered animated artwork and updated branding.




Added the Refuge dimension, custom NPCs, dialogue, and protection scripts.




Disabled the automatic starting class scroll.




Changed the recommended RAM allocation from 10 GB to 8 GB.




Gameplay adjustments



Disabled Nameless Trinkets crafting.




Disabled the Illuminati Pet’s item-generation ability.




Disabled the End Portal and Juggernaut pets and removed their crafting recipes.




Updated RPG equipment and spell-scroll loot settings.




Updated configuration files for several mods.




Added mods



Create: Aeroworks




Create: Deep Seas




Create: Dragons Plus




AEInfinityBooster




RPG Style More Weapons




Sablewaves




EMI Autocrafting

FancyMenu, Konkrete, and Melody




KubeJS and Rhino




WorldEdit and WorldEdit Items




Removed mods



Legendary Monsters




Legendary Monsters Create Compat




Legendary Spellbooks




Nera Jadis: Arcane Arsenal




Sea Myths




FramedBlocks




Mod updates

Updated 30 mods, including Ice and Fire Community Edition, Spell Engine, the RPG Series class mods, Create: Interiors, Create: Flight Control, Create Aeronautics Discovery, Gadgets & Gizmos, Abyssal Ocean, Lootr, and several libraries and compatibility addons.

Updating an existing installation

Back up your world before updating. Removed mods’ blocks, items, and entities may be lost, including existing FramedBlocks builds. Replace the old quest folder instead of merging it so removed quests do not remain.

changelog.title: Mythforge-1.0.2.zip
changelog.notes:
What's new

Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon 1.0.2

Long-distance exploration gets a major visual upgrade, alongside new music systems, loot notifications and compatibility updates.

357 mods (up from 352).

Added



Distant Horizons - adds level-of-detail terrain rendering, allowing the world to remain visible far beyond Minecraft's normal render distance




Loot Journal: Pickup Notifier - displays newly collected items and loot without needing to constantly check your inventory




Maestro - dynamic music framework for expanding and controlling Minecraft's soundtrack




Maestro: Overture - expanded soundtrack and music experience built for Maestro




Fragmentum - supporting library required by the new Obscuria mods




YetAnotherConfigLib - configuration library required by the new additions




Updated



Legendary Monsters → 2.2.3




Streams Reflowing → 2.13.7




These updates also bring additional fixes and compatibility improvements for the pack's Create and Sable-heavy environment.

changelog.title: Mythforge-1.0.1.zip
changelog.notes:
## Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon 1.0.1

Computers and automation join the pack, plus a round of mod updates.

**352 mods** (up from 347).

### Added
- **CC: Tweaked** - programmable in-game computers, turtles and peripherals
- **CC: Sable** - connects CC: Tweaked to the Sable physics engine, so you can
  script your airships directly
- **Advanced Peripherals** - extended peripheral set for CC: Tweaked
- **Create: Avionics** - computer-controlled flight systems
- **Minor Gamba** - two uncraftable gambling machines: a gacha machine that
  outputs any item in the game, and a simple double-or-nothing

Together these mean an airship can now be flown by a Lua program instead of a
player.

### Updated
- Aeronautics Player Tilt → 0.2.0
- Ars 'n Spells → 3.3.4
- Azimuth API → 1.4.8
- Create: Bits 'n' Bobs → 2.3.5
- Create: Creating Space → 1.7.22
- Create: Flight Control → 0.7.2
- Moog's Structure Lib → 3.3.1

policies.terms:
Effective October 13, 2026

About Mythforge
Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon is an independently operated Minecraft modpack and community server. The operator uses the name Procyonine. Contact the Mythforge team at admin@mythforge.win or through the official Discord linked on the Contact page. These terms cover mythforge.win and play.mythforge.win; external services have their own terms.

Agreement and eligibility
These terms and the published Server Rules apply when you use Mythforge. If you do not agree, do not use the services. Follow the age and account requirements of Minecraft, Microsoft, Discord, and any other provider you use. Where your local law requires a parent or guardian’s permission, obtain that permission before using the service.

Using the service
Use a legitimately owned Minecraft Java Edition account and the latest published Mythforge release. Follow the Server Rules and applicable laws. Keep your account secure. Do not disrupt the infrastructure, impersonate staff, distribute malware, evade moderation, or exploit other players.

Community and moderation
Staff may investigate reports and restrict access for rule violations or security and performance concerns. Staff may pause, modify, or remove harmful machines, items, or builds. You may appeal through the official Discord and ask staff to review the evidence and context. An appeal does not guarantee that a restriction will be lifted. Sharing a build or playing on the server does not transfer ownership of your original work to Mythforge.

Content you share
You retain rights in original content you create. When you share a build, message, screenshot, or technical report through our services, you allow staff to store, display, and review it as needed to operate the community, provide support, or investigate moderation and security issues. This does not grant permission to use your work in unrelated advertising. Share only material you have permission to share, and do not publish another person’s private information.

Security reports
Report suspected vulnerabilities and compromised accounts privately through the Contact page. Do not exploit a vulnerability, access other players’ information, or disrupt services while investigating a problem.

Updates and world data
The modpack and server change over time. Bugs, interruptions, balancing changes, rollbacks, and world resets may occur. We do not promise uninterrupted access or permanent preservation of every build or item. Where practical, important changes will be announced through community channels. Nothing here removes rights that applicable law requires us to respect.

Supporter services
No supporter packages are currently offered for purchase. Proposed rewards and playtime unlocks are not purchase promises. Before paid offers open, their contents, price, duration, billing conditions, delivery process, and applicable purchase terms will be published. Payments will be handled through the external provider identified at checkout; this website does not collect card details.

External services and intellectual property
Minecraft, mod content, and third-party assets remain subject to their respective owners’ licenses and terms. Discord, CurseForge, hosting, and any future checkout provider operate their own services. Mythforge does not replace their account or purchase agreements.

Changes and contact
Updated terms will show a new effective date. Contact the operator through the Contact page if you have a question or dispute. Any future purchase is also subject to the terms disclosed for that transaction; a later website update does not automatically remove existing consumer rights.

policies.privacy:
Effective October 13, 2026

Who operates this service
Mythforge is operated under the name Procyonine. For privacy questions or requests, email admin@mythforge.win or contact staff privately through the official Discord on the Contact page. Do not post sensitive information in public chat.

Website visits
This website has no visitor account system, advertising tracker, analytics script, or payment form in its supplied code. Cloudflare hosts the website and may process IP addresses, request timestamps, browser information, and security logs to deliver and protect it. The site does not set advertising or analytics cookies in its own code; infrastructure or external services may have their own practices.

Server status
The Server page requests status from mcstatus.io. When your browser makes this request, that provider receives your IP address and normal request information, plus the public server hostname. It queries Minecraft’s public status response. The site displays availability and player totals, not a list of player names. Status results can be cached and may lag behind the server. mcstatus.io has its own service practices.

Minecraft server and support
Operating a multiplayer server involves Minecraft usernames and UUIDs, connection addresses, gameplay and chat logs, world and claim data, and moderation records. Information you send to staff may include Discord identifiers, messages, screenshots, and technical logs. This information is used to operate the world, investigate problems, enforce rules, and respond to support requests. In-game chat may be visible to other players; information submitted to public Discord channels is visible to their audiences.

Providers and sharing
Cloudflare, Discord, Minecraft account services, and CurseForge process information under their own policies when you use their services. Server administrators and relevant hosting providers may have access to operational data. A future checkout provider will handle payment information under the terms shown at checkout. This static website does not collect card numbers. Information may also need to be disclosed when required by law or to address a security incident.

Storage and privacy requests
Logs, world saves, backups, and support records may persist after a session ends. Contact staff to request access, correction, or deletion of information relating to you. We may need to verify account ownership and may need to keep records for security, moderation, backups, or legal obligations. Removing a record from active systems may not immediately remove it from backups. Applicable privacy rights depend on your location and the circumstances.

Children and sensitive information
Do not send identity documents, payment credentials, or other unnecessary sensitive information to staff. Discord users must meet Discord’s applicable age requirements. A parent or guardian may contact us about information relating to a child. Child-specific data collection or services require a separate review before introduction.

Public credits and privacy requests
The Beta Testers & Thanks page publishes the credited players’ Minecraft names and current head images using public UUIDs. A credited player can contact staff privately to ask for correction or removal from the page. Gameplay and moderation records are handled separately from public credits. Depending on applicable law, you may also request a copy of your information or object to or ask us to restrict particular processing. Explain the request through the Contact page; staff may need to confirm account ownership. If we cannot fulfill all of a request, we will explain the applicable reason and any records that must be retained. You may contact your local privacy regulator where you have that right.

Retention and access
Records are kept for service operation, support, security, moderation, backups, and legal obligations as described above. Different records may have different retention needs; this policy does not promise a fixed deletion period that has not been implemented. Operational information is intended for staff and providers who need it for those purposes. Ask staff about the records relating to your account.

International services
Third-party providers may process requests and records in countries different from yours. Their privacy policies explain their own processing and safeguards. Public website credits can be viewed worldwide.

Updates
This policy will be updated if the site adds accounts, analytics, payments, or other material changes in data handling. A new effective date will identify the revised version.
policies.refunds:
Effective October 13, 2026

Current purchase status
The Mythforge supporter store is closed. No supporter packages are offered for purchase on this website, and proposed package names or rewards are not purchasable offers.

Future purchases
When the store opens, review the package description and the payment provider’s terms before paying. Those terms must identify the price, duration, recurring billing if any, and applicable cancellation and refund conditions. This page does not establish a blanket “no refunds” rule or promise a discretionary refund window for a store that has not launched. Statutory consumer rights are not excluded.

Delivery problems and duplicate charges
If a future purchase is missing, incorrect, or charged twice, contact Mythforge staff privately through the Contact page with your receipt or transaction reference, Minecraft username, package name, and purchase date. Do not send card details or passwords. Staff will investigate delivery issues and coordinate with the checkout provider where appropriate. Do not purchase the package again merely to fix a delivery problem.

Provider support and subscriptions
Use the checkout provider’s receipt and support tools for payment or billing questions. If Tebex is selected, its purchase terms and payment-history tools will apply to the relevant checkout. Cancelling a subscription and requesting a refund are different actions; review the terms of the actual offer.

Rewards and reversals
Where a payment is refunded or reversed, rewards tied to that payment may be revoked under the applicable offer and provider terms. Separately earned playtime unlocks are not paid purchases and should not be removed solely because a supporter purchase was reversed.

Before the store opens
This page will be updated with the actual provider and package conditions before purchases are enabled. Contact staff if you have any questions.
